name: Calendar
description: Monthly calendar or agenda with iCal and media event sources

fields.help: Days before today in agenda view. Default: 0.
Optional IANA time zone, for example America/Los_Angeles. Blank uses the detected zone.

name: IFrame
description: Embed a page that permits framing

fields.title: Height and CSS classes
fields.help: Optional Tailwind classes; default height is h-60 (2xl:h-72).

fields.title: Permissions policy
fields.help: Optional iframe allow attribute; grant only the features the embedded page needs.
Optional refresh interval in milliseconds; minimum 1000.

name: Velociraptor
description: Client counts through the mutual TLS gRPC API

fields.title: API client file path
fields.help: Path inside the Gather container, e.g. /app/config/velociraptor-api.yaml. Mount the generated file read-only. It contains the API address, CA certificate, client certificate and private key; this editor never reads its contents. The API identity needs ANY_QUERY and READ_RESULTS.

fields.title: Organization ID
fields.help: Optional; blank uses the root organization.
Recent means seen within 15 minutes. Leave empty for default fields.

name: Wazuh
description: Agent connection counts from the Wazuh manager API

fields.help: Manager API URL, usually https://wazuh.example.net:55000. Use an API account with agent:read access.
API user password or an unresolved {{HOMEPAGE_VAR_WAZUH_PASSWORD}} reference. Gather renews the token automatically.
Leave empty to show the default fields.
